Prothetic w 'was inserted between # and round vowels'; later developments unrounded the vowels, and synchronically it is kept only before non-round segments (*eno > wɛn-, *onom > wene-, *ponu > weey, *?una > wine, *puki > wik). Initial wi and u vary freely in wirɛnna ~ urɛnna 'lobster'.

Stated against POC (§§4-5); restated against PPON through the POc > PMc > ... > PPON rows of Bender et al. (2003a). A high vowel becomes a glide next to a vowel (a mirror-image rule, p. 305); also the final glide of forms like aay < *api (p. 299).

Stated against POC (§§4-5); restated against PPON through the POc > PMc > ... > PPON rows of Bender et al. (2003a). Kept back where the vowel is long or the stem ends in a short non-high vowel (p. 302).

Stated against POC (§§4-5); restated against PPON through the POc > PMc > ... > PPON rows of Bender et al. (2003a). Short final *u was fronted to i (*walu > wɛli-, *pitu > isi-), and vowel harmony fronts a non-final *u before a final *i or fronted *u (*kuli > kiil, *kuku > kiik, *tusu(k) > it). Exceptions: *?umu, *muntu, *punti, *tuki keep u (p. 304).
